[[File:Risen ghost icon.png|left]]
'''Risen ghosts''' are [[Slayer monsters]] accessible following [[Unwelcome Guests]]. They require level 85 [[Slayer]] to kill, and are found within the [[Crypt (Wilderness)|crypt]] north of [[Fort Forinthry]]. 

Risen ghosts fall under multiple Slayer categories; as themselves, [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|undead]], [[Zemouregal's undead]], and [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|ghosts]]. When killed as a standalone task, every kill counts as one towards the assignment. If killed on a [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|ghosts]], [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|undead]], or [[Zemouregal's undead]] assignments, every kill counts as two, and while killing them on [[Slayer/Challenges#The Raptor|the Raptor's slayer challenge]], they count as three kills each.

==Mechanics==
The risen ghost has a passive effect, [[Soul Siphon]], that allows its attacks to partially bypass damage mitigation. Additionally, it possesses an energy bar that once filled allows the ghost to heal with its attacks for a time.

== Strategy ==
The ghosts are permanently aggressive, and can overwhelm players easily with their high magic damage output. Players can engage the ghosts near the bridge to avoid pulling the main group. Usage of Protect/Soul Split curses is highly recommended.
